claims.text: Diuretics = the cornerstone of Sx tx for congestion, but use cautiously: RCM pts are highly preload dep, and excess diuresis can ↓CO and cause hypotension.
claims.quote: Volume management with diuretics is the cornerstone of symptomatic treatment for congestion; however, diuretics must be used cautiously because patients with RCM are highly preload dependent, and excessive diuresis may result in reduced cardiac output and hypotension.
